description: A task packet is the durable handoff unit. It is a superset of the CO_WORKFLOW.md handoff packet, adding the fields a delegated agent needs to work in an isolated worktree without conversation history.
crossPacketInvariants: two packets that are open at the same time must not name the same WORKTREE
a packet's BASE_SHA is fixed for the life of the packet; re-baselining means writing a new packet
a verifier packet must not name the executor's worktree
parsing: HTML comments are stripped before parsing
for fields listed in constraints, the value is the first non-empty line of the section
